Platform Features

Built for premium storytelling.

A complete creative toolkit designed to localize video content with accuracy, clarity, and intention.

Multilingual dubbing

Translate and localize dialogue into natural, culturally aware speech across markets.

Expressive AI voices

Create lifelike vocal performances with nuanced emotion, pacing, and clarity.

Speech recognition

Accurate transcription from multilingual dialogue and dynamic soundscapes.

Segment-based editing

Refine each line independently without reworking the whole project.

Prompt-based revisions

Guide the voice with natural prompts to adjust intensity, warmth, and mood.

Tone control

Tune pacing and delivery to match each scene, speaker, and emotional beat.

Audio sync

Align dubbed audio with actor timing, background ambience, and cinematic rhythm.

Studio-grade export

Deliver a clean final mix with premium-quality output and polished finishing.
